sources.snippet: Pix2Struct Tiny Random is an experimental image-to-text model released by Google with randomly initialized weights, primarily used for algorithm validation and development testing. It supports extracting structured information from images, making it suitable for researchers exploring vision-language model architectures and for prototyping and dataset preprocessing in multimodal learning.
